Jeff, saw Nextech launched Cora Scribe and won 2026 Best in KLAS for ophthalmology, alongside an expanded payments platform.

New capabilities and recognition usually open more in-market accounts than the team can touch before reps ramp on the message, and that is where pipeline cools. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for your region off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
